# Dailyledger

> Daily Ledger is a personal planner for tasks, habits, goals, money, workouts, meals, reminders and reports.

## Account access

- [Login](https://app.dailyledger.store/login): Sign in to the Daily Ledger app.
- [Sign up](https://app.dailyledger.store/signup): Create a Daily Ledger account.
- [Forgot password](https://app.dailyledger.store/forgot-password): Recover account access.

## Plans and AI

The Free plan does not require a credit card. The 7-day Pro trial requires a credit card. The AI assistant is a Pro/Lifetime feature; it proposes actions and saves nothing until the user confirms. Current prices and allowances are on the Pricing page and in the app.
